# Coordinates

Free browser-local GPS coordinate converter and interactive world time globe by whispr.dev.

Convert WGS 84 latitude/longitude between decimal and DMS. Select a city or a point on the globe to see its coordinates and civil clock. All required scripts and map data are served locally.

See about.html for data sources and accuracy limits, privacy.html for privacy information, and https://skeletrace.com/ for the SkeleTrace suite.
